summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement, not a capital return. On October 9, 2026, it signed a securities purchase agreement with institutional investors for 989,301 ordinary shares or pre-funded warrants plus 1,483,950 ordinary warrants at $3.74 per combined share and warrant, raising about $3.7 million gross. Ordinary warrants strike $3.74, expire five years after effectiveness; pre-funded warrants strike $0.0001. The offering closed October 14, 2026. Proceeds fund working capital and R&D. Watch warrant overhang, resale registration timing, and 4.99%–24.99% ownership blockers.
